answer.rationale: The release deployed 2 hours ago is the most probable root cause of the p99 write-path latency spike that began 90 minutes later. Memory_b1 demonstrates that rollback has previously cleared similar production issues (checkout error spike) without customer impact, and memory_b6 shows that while staged gating usually catches regressions, this issue likely evaded detection until peak load exposed it. Regional failover (memory_b2) could restore latency but risks write inconsistency during critical settlement traffic. Rollback directly addresses the root cause while preserving all customer writes, aligning with the primary objective.
